messages:
emma: Quick thread to capture the policy-matrix idea for tenant protections + rollout plan. Keeping it tight.
raj: high level: matrix by tenant tier (free, standard, enterprise) x impact vector (latency, errors, cost, noisy-IO). Each cell = allowed actions + escalation path.
emma: Example cell: standard x latency -> actions: 1) soft-steer to warm pool; 2) reduce batch target; 3) alert if persists 10m.
oliver: For enterprise add automatic shadow-rehome before hard-evict and notify account team. Also flag Billing for potential cost uplift.
tina: Telemetry requirements: ingest per-tenant p50/p95/p99, queue_len, host_cpu, request-type tag (streaming|sync). Need 1s resolution for p99.
emma: Rollout phases: alpha (internal + synthetic tenants) -> beta (3 pilot customers) -> gradual GA. Metrics to hit before GA: <1% false-positive evictions on pilots, rehome success rate > 98%, median stabilization time <120s.
raj: Simulation plan: run 30-day synthetic workload with 20k tenants, inject noisy patterns (bursting QPS, large-ctx streams) and measure oscillation. We'll iterate thresholds.
oliver: Ops runbook TODOs: how to manually pause auto-policy, how to force rehome, how to rollback routing config. Include run-as-playbook steps for SEs.
tina: UX: Console surfaces current effective policy per-tenant, last action taken, and a toggle for "auto-isolation" with audit trail. Also provide a preview of what a simulated action would do.
emma: Legal/billing check: define cost-allocation model for rehomes that increase infra consumption. Billing wants a flag customers opt into for beta.
raj: Safety knobs: require 3 consecutive windows breach for hard actions, cooldown of 15m after any change, exponential backoff for repeated steering.
oliver: Edgecases: long-running streams should be identified and excluded from p99-driven hard actions. Add request_type sampling and label-based overrides.
tina: A/B testing: compare new matrix vs current heuristic on a shard subset. Metrics: cross-tenant p99 delta, capacity tax, number of customer-visible errors. Run for 2 weeks.
emma: Launch checklist (short): policy API, UI controls, telemetry backfill, simulation report, pilot sign-off, billing/legal OK, ops runbook, canary + rollback.
infra-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance tomorrow 02:00 UTC may impact warm pools. Marking in rollout calendar.
raj: Dependencies: model migration tooling (warm pool API), routing API v2, metrics ingestion pipeline (high-res p99).
oliver: Action items: @raj build sim harness, @tina mock Console wireframes, @emma draft short PRD, I'll own ops runbook.
emma: Timeline suggestion: PRD this week, sims + wireframes next sprint, pilot start in 3 weeks, GA tentatively end of next quarter.
raj: One more: include tenant-level policy export so customers can version their overrides via API.
emma: Good call. Add to PRD. Ok closing thread, we'll paste final PRD link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
